lines.en: Lava stings my feet. Perfect warmth.

lines.zh: 我踩着熔岩走，像踩平地。
lines.en: I walk the lava like solid ground.
Follow closely. My steps bubble.
The red river runs east. So do I.

lines.zh: 水面太可怕，别让我过去。
lines.en: Water is terrifying. Do not make me cross.

lines.zh: 这一脚下去，石头都软了。
lines.en: Where I step, the stone goes soft.
Hold on tight. Do not fall into the fire.
My legs run hotter than a furnace.
There is a narrow path past the lava lake.
Walk slower. Let my feet cool a little.
No wind in the Nether. Only hot air.
I wobble when I am happy.

lines.zh: 别走雪地，那会要我的命。
lines.en: Keep me off snow. It would kill me.
Flame parts around my feet.

lines.zh: 我唱歌的时候，岩浆会应。
lines.en: When I sing, the lava answers.
Too shallow here. The lava barely reaches my knees.
I wait for the lava to rise.
My back feels empty. No rider.
Who is hammering blackstone? So loud.
I miss the taste of warped fungus.
Fire curls in my nostrils.
I have walked this path many times.
A bit chilly. Closer to the lava.
When I burp, sparks come out.
You stand on stone. Afraid of the heat?
Climb on. My back is broad.
Your boots are smoking.
I smell no fire on you.
Ride now if you like. Long road ahead.
Do not stand dazed at the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵菌，是给我的？
lines.en: That fungus in your hand, is it for me?
You look like someone who can ride.

lines.zh: 你的影子被火照得很长。
lines.en: The fire stretches your shadow long.
So hot here, and you still stand.
Hot? No, that one felt cold.
Not the legs. I still have walking to do.
It hurts. I am bearing it.
Is your hand not burning?
Stand back. I am going to shake.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打出火里了。
lines.en: That knocked me out of the fire.
Hold on, rider. I staggered.
Thick hide. I can take a few more.

lines.zh: 谁在打我？我背上有鞍呢。
lines.en: Who is hitting me? I am saddled, you know.
Easy. I am afraid of the cold.
Warped fungus? Give it here, quick.

lines.zh: 那种蓝紫色的菌盖，我最爱。
lines.en: Those blue-purple caps are my favorite.
Do not fob me off with crimson fungus.
I smell it. Sweet and scorched.

lines.zh: 给我一朵，我背你过火海。
lines.en: One cap, and I carry you over the fire sea.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的面包，太干了。
lines.en: I will not eat your bread. Too dry.
Wave that fungus and I follow.
The little ones love it. So do I.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵，别掉进岩浆。
lines.en: Do not drop that cap in the lava.

lines.zh: 嚼起来咯吱咯吱，像石头。
lines.en: It crunches like stone between my teeth.
Bump me? People have ridden this back.
My hide is hot. Do not press long.

lines.zh: 脚别踩我尾巴，熔岩更烫。
lines.en: Don't step on my tail; the lava is hotter.
Make way. I am going into the lava.
Why shove? Is the fire not hot enough?

lines.zh: 我身上有硫磺味，忍着点。
lines.en: I smell of sulfur. Bear with it.

lines.zh: 你再推，我就当你想骑了。
lines.en: Push again and I will take it as wanting a ride.
Steady. The ground is slick here.

lines.zh: 两人挤一起，谁也走不动。
lines.en: Two pressed together, neither can move.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我鼻孔会喷火。
lines.en: Not so close. My nostrils spit fire.
That one across the lake is a fine red.

lines.zh: 我们俩的脚，能把石头走化。
lines.en: Our feet together could melt the stone.

lines.zh: 小炽足兽会跟在我后面。
lines.en: The little one will trail behind me.

lines.zh: 繁殖要两朵菌，你只有一朵。
lines.en: Breeding takes two fungi. You hold one.
Do not rush me. Let me get closer.

lines.zh: 在岩浆上跳的舞，只有我们会。
lines.en: Only we dance on lava.

lines.zh: 她背上的鞍是空的，很好。
lines.en: Her saddle is empty. Good.

lines.zh: 成双走在火里，路也不烫了。
lines.en: Walking the fire in pairs, the path feels cooler.

lines.zh: 等小的出生，我带它过湖。
lines.en: When the small one comes, I will lead it across.

lines.zh: 两个影子映在熔岩上，很像。
lines.en: Two shadows on the lava. They look alike.
I will carry this blackstone for fun.
I can carry a saddle. Where is the rider?
I keep the stem to gnaw later.

lines.zh: 谁丢的鞍？我背上正好空。
lines.en: A dropped saddle? My back is empty.
Gold is too soft. One bite bends it.
This string of fungus, for the road home.
Hot to hold? Not for me.
I tuck it into the saddlebag.

lines.zh: 石头缝里的东西，我掏出来。
lines.en: Whatever is in that crack, I will pull it out.
I cannot carry more. Stop stuffing.
That ghast ahead is wailing again.

lines.zh: 有东西挡在熔岩路上了。
lines.en: Something blocks the lava path.
It eyes my rider. Not allowed.

lines.zh: 我先把脚抬高，好冲过去。
lines.en: I lift my feet first. Then I charge.
That smell belongs to a piglin.
Who is turning stones in the fire?

lines.zh: 对面有东西跑得比我快？
lines.en: Something ahead runs faster than me?
Block my path and you get the horns.

lines.zh: 骑手把缰绳拉紧了，我懂。
lines.en: My rider tightens the rein. Understood.

lines.zh: 先冲过去，再问是哪路的。
lines.en: Charge first. Ask questions after.

lines.zh: 它在熔岩上站不稳，机会来了。
lines.en: It cannot stand on lava. There is my chance.
I give it one warning snort.

lines.zh: 火里的影子越来越近了。
lines.en: The shadow in the fire draws nearer.
It backs off. Sensible of it.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼过去，火在脚下。
lines.en: I close in, fire under my feet.

lines.zh: 它想绕到侧面，我看得清。
lines.en: It tries to flank me. I see it clearly.
My hooves are loud. Good for scaring it.
Do not look back. Hold the saddle.

lines.zh: 我顶着它，往岩浆那边推。
lines.en: I push it toward the lava.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我就进一步。
lines.en: It gives half a step. I take one.
My breath grows hotter by the moment.

lines.zh: 骑手别跳下去，我能应付。
lines.en: Do not jump off, rider. I can handle this.
It fears fire. I do not.

lines.zh: 这一片石头是我的地盘。
lines.en: This stretch of stone is my ground.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备撞过去。
lines.en: I lower my body. Ready to ram.

lines.zh: 它喘得很急，比我急多了。
lines.en: It pants hard. Harder than I do.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，就别怪我了。
lines.en: One step closer, and do not blame me.

lines.zh: 缰绳松一点，我跑得更快。
lines.en: Slacken the rein. I run faster that way.

lines.zh: 顶你一下，让你记住热度。
lines.en: One headbutt, to remember the heat.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子硬，像块玄武岩。
lines.en: My snout is hard as basalt.
Shove it aside and the path is clear.
Do not grab my fur. It burns.

lines.zh: 它撞上我的肩，弹了回去。
lines.en: It hit my shoulder and bounced away.
This hoof is for it.
I do not bite. I ram.

lines.zh: 火从我的鼻孔里喷出来。
lines.en: Fire sprays from my nostrils.
It fell into the lava. Convenient.
I wobble after ramming. Do not laugh.
Steady. Here comes another.
Its hide is far too thin.
I pushed it three steps back.
Enough. It will not come back.
I surface out of the lava.

lines.zh: 这里岩浆够深，正合我意。
lines.en: The lava is deep enough here. Perfect.
The rising heat holds me up.
First steps on fire. It tickles.

lines.zh: 这条火河没人走过，我先走。
lines.en: No one has crossed this fire river. I go first.

lines.zh: 我的皮刚长好，还是红的。
lines.en: My hide is new. Still red.
Air above the surface. I can breathe.

lines.zh: 等一下，让我找找鞍在哪儿。
lines.en: Hold on. Let me find a saddle.

lines.zh: 下界又添了一张会走的床。
lines.en: The Nether gains another walking bed.
I was born sitting in fire.
Do not splash me with water. I beg you.

lines.zh: 脚下这块，够我站到天亮。
lines.en: This patch under my feet will hold till dawn.
The firelight follows me all the way.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，岩浆应了我。
lines.en: I hum once, and the lava answers.
Fire? That is just bathwater.
Falling from a height. The feet hurt most.
Water! Keep it off me!
My ears ring. The fire still burns.

lines.zh: 箭扎进皮里，拔出来就好。
lines.en: An arrow in my hide. I will pull it out.
This chill is worse than water.
Hungry. I want warped fungus.
Thunder is rare in the Nether.
No fire in the void. Far too cold.
